The bioengineering corporation [[Xenovet]] once possessed a '''research facility''' focusing on the development of various [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] on the planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Ysanne Isard (clone)|clone]] of [[Ysanne Isard]] transferred her [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] there, paying for their housing to Xenovet's trustee, [[Mem Wooter]]. Eventually, Xenovet went bankrupt and the clone remained in control of the facility.
